parameters.formDescription: Upload one or more purchase order PDFs to extract line items.

parameters.content:
## 📄 Form Intake
Collects the purchase order PDFs from the user. **Multiple files** can be uploaded in one submission. Only **.pdf** is accepted and at least one file is required.

## ✂️ Split & Seed
Builds the **seen-PO list** from the sheet rows it receives, then resets the run's flag, duplicate and count buffers. It then pulls the uploaded files from the form and splits them into **one item per PDF**, renaming each binary to `data` (the name the Extractor expects).

## 🔁 One PO at a time
Batch size **1**. The Extractor bundles all inputs into a single call, so each PDF must pass through on its own. The **loop** output processes each PO, the **done** output fires once at the end.

## 🚩 Build Warnings
Reads the flags collected during the run and builds the message for the end screen. If nothing was flagged, it reports a **clean extraction**. Runs once, on the loop's **done** output.

## 🤖 Extract with easybits
Reads the header fields and the full article table from one PDF. Output is wrapped in a `data` envelope. Field setup lives in the Extractor credential – see the main note for the field list and descriptions.

## 🧩 Flatten to Rows
Turns each PO into **one row per article**, stapling the header fields (PO Number, dates, Mark For, PR Number) onto every line. Adds the **Document Name**. Cleans every empty value (`null`, `NULL`, `""`, blanks) to an empty cell and **records a flag** per document if anything is missing.

## 📊 Write to Sheet
Appends every article row to the Google Sheet. **RAW** value mode keeps quantities and special characters literal. Columns map automatically – the header row in the sheet must match the field names exactly.

## ✅ End Screen
Shows the user the result after processing. Lists **which documents and which fields** may not have extracted fully, so they know what to double-check against the original PDF.

## 📦 Purchase Order Extractor (powered by easybits)

Upload one or more purchase order PDFs through a simple form. The workflow reads the **header details** and the **full article table** from each PO, writes everything to a Google Sheet (**one row per article**, with the parent PO fields repeated on each line), and can optionally generate an **EDI 850** file per PO for direct ERP integration. Duplicate POs are detected and skipped, and the completion screen reports anything missing or already processed.

## 🔧 How the flow works
**Form** collects the PDFs and the EDI toggle → **Read** loads existing PO numbers from the sheet → **Split & Seed** prepares the files and the duplicate list → **Loop** feeds one PDF at a time → **Extract** pulls the data → **Check** decides new versus duplicate. New POs are flattened to **rows** and written to the **Sheet**; when the toggle is on, they also build a canonical object, generate the **850**, and save it to **Drive**. A styled **summary** is shown at the end.

## 📝 Google Sheet setup
Create a sheet with these headers in row 1, matching exactly:
`Date | Customer | Supplier | LPO No | Delivery Date | Items | Unit | Qty | Rate | Total | Document Name`
Connect it in the **Append** node and the **Read** node, and set the Append value mode to **RAW**. The dedup check reads the **LPO No** column, so keep that header intact.

## ☁️ Extractor setup (n8n Cloud)
The `@easybits/n8n-nodes-extractor` node is **verified** and available natively on n8n Cloud – just search for it when adding a node. Create an easybits account at https://extractor.easybits.tech/, generate an **API key**, and add it as the node credential. The free plan covers **10 fields per call** and **50 requests per month**.

## 📌 Extractor fields
Set a short, layout-neutral document description, then define these fields, each told to return `null` when a value is absent: **customer**, **supplier**, **currency**, **po_number**, **po_date** (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`), **delivery_date** (ISO), and an **articles** array with **article**, **unit**, **quantity**, **rate**. The **currency** field is the one to drop first if you need to stay inside the free-plan field budget.

## ⚠️ Good to know
Dates are normalised to ISO so mixed day-first and month-first PO formats resolve correctly. The **currency** field defaults to `AED` in code when a PO does not state one, so it can be removed without breaking the 850.

nodes.name: Call 'Purchase Order Extractor Workflow – Generate EDI 850'

parameters.content:
## 📖 Load Processed POs
Reads the master sheet once at the start of every run so the workflow knows which purchase orders already exist. Only the **LPO No** column is used, to build the duplicate-check list.

## 🔍 Duplicate Check
Compares each extracted **PO Number** against the seen list. A new PO is remembered and passed on; one already on file is tagged `_duplicate` and recorded for the completion screen.

## 🚦 New or Skip
Routes the sheet path by the `_duplicate` tag. **New** POs go on to the row builder and the sheet, while **duplicates** return straight to the loop so nothing is written and the loop keeps moving.

## ⚙️ EDI Toggle
Fires only when the form toggle **Generate EDI 850 file** is `Yes` and the PO is not a duplicate. This keeps the 850 branch off by default and stops duplicate files being created.

## 🧱 Canonical PO
Reshapes the extractor output into a clean nested object, a **header** plus a **lines** array, in the shape the EDI sub-workflow expects. Cleans every value and defaults the currency to `AED` and any missing unit to `EA`.

## 📞 Generate 850
Passes the canonical PO object to the **Generate: EDI 850** sub-workflow, which returns the finished `.edi` file. Set to **run once for each item** so every PO produces its own file.

## ☁️ Save 850
Uploads each returned `.edi` file to the Drive folder. The branch ends here and does not loop back; users open the folder in Drive to collect the files.
